Spells:
Arcane Eye (Hags Eye Hex4 Divi): Allows seeing through an invisible remote sensor that can be moved 30' per rd for 20 min
Comprehend Languages (Tongues Hex1 Divi): Allows self to understand written text and words spoken in any language for 200 min
Control Weather (Weather Control Hex7 Tran): Modifies seasonal weather in a 2 mile radius for 4d12 hr
Cure Critical Wounds (Major Healing Hex4 Conj): Touched regains 4d8+20 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Cure Light Wounds (Healing Hex1 Conj): Touched regains 1d8+5 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Cure Moderate Wounds (Healing Hex2 Conj): Touched regains 2d8+10 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Cure Serious Wounds (Major Healing Hex3 Conj): Touched regains 3d8+15 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Disguise Self (Disguise Hex1 Illu): Changes the appearance of self (save Will upon interaction disbelieves) and gives +10 Disguise, for 200 min
Earthquake (Natural Disaster Hex8 Evoc): R1200' Intense tremor shakes an 80' radius for 1 rd, prohibiting movement, breaking spell concentration (DC 20 + spell level concentration negates), collapsing caverns, cliffs, and structures that inflict 8d6 HP (save Reflex DC 15 half) and pin creatures in the rubble, knocking down creatures on open ground (save Reflex DC 15 negates) and opening fissures with a 25% chance to fall in (save Reflex DC 20 negates)
Feather Fall (Flight Hex1 Tran): R75' 20 falling targets in a 10' radius slow to 60' per rd (save Will negates) for 20 rd
Fly (Flight Hex3 Tran): Touched gains a 60' fly Speed and +10 Fly skill for 20 min, then floats downward 60' per rd for 1d6 rd (save Will negates)
Levitate (Flight Hex2 Tran): R75' Allows using a move action each rd to raise or lower an object or a willing target 20' each rd for 20 min
Nightmare (Nightmares Hex5 Illu): Specified sleeping target suffers 1d10 HP, fatigue, and inability to regain arcane spells for 24 hr (save Will negates, modified from +10 to -5 based on familiarity with the target)
Reincarnate (Forced Reincarnation Hex5 Tran): Uses part of a corpse, dead up to 1 week, to restore a willing soul to full health in a generated body
Resurrection (Life Giver Hex7 Conj): Fully restores a target willing soul, dead up to 200 years, using a piece of its corpse; the target gains a permanent negative level (level 1 targets instead suffer 2 points of Constitution drain)
Scrying (Scry On Familiar4 Divi): Self sees and hears a 10' radius around the target (save Will, modified by familiarity and connection with the target, negates for 24 hr) for 20 min
Sleep (Slumber Hex1 Ench): R300' 4 HD of creatures in a 10' radius fall asleep (save Will negates), moving upward from those with the lowest HD, for 20 min; shaking or wounding wakens an affected creature, but noise does not
Storm Of Vengeance (Natural Disaster Hex9 Conj): R1200' 360' radius storm inflicts deafened for 1d4x10 min (save Fortitude negates), then produces rain that inflicts 1d6 HP acid, then generates lightning bolts that inflict 10d6 HP electricity on 6 targets (save Reflex half), then creates hail that inflicts 5d6 HP bludgeoning, then produces violent wind and rain that reduce Speed by 3/4 and obscure vision, giving a 20% miss chance on attacks within 5' and a 50% miss chance on more distant attacks, for 6 rd; the storm also prevents ranged attacks and disrupts spellcasting (save Concentration negates; add the level of the spell to be cast to the DC)
Tongues (Tongues Hex3 Divi): Allows touched to communicate in any language (save Will negates) for 200 min
